description: This file defines the AliasKeyManager class, which implements the X509KeyManager interface to customize SSL certificate alias selection in Java SSL contexts.

classes.name: AliasKeyManager
classes.description: A custom implementation of X509KeyManager to specify a certificate alias for SSL connections.

methods.name: chooseClientAlias
methods.description: Selects a client alias matching the specified alias, key types, and issuers.

methods.name: chooseServerAlias
methods.description: Delegates server alias selection to the wrapped keyManager.

methods.name: chooseServerAlias
methods.description: Overloaded method to select server alias with socket and issuers.

methods.name: getCertificateChain
methods.description: Retrieves the certificate chain for a given alias.

methods.name: getClientAliases
methods.description: Returns available client aliases for a given key type and issuers.

methods.name: getPrivateKey
methods.description: Retrieves the private key for a given alias.

methods.name: getServerAliases
methods.description: Returns available server aliases for a given key type and issuers.
